ICYMI is a form of the internet phenomenon of the initialism, or initial-word acronym. Initialisms are acronyms, but instead of being pronounced as a word (as in NASA), they are pronounced by their component letters (as in FBI). The initialism is not a recent phenomenon, but it has become far more widespread with the growth of digital communication, as it allows for rapid, abbreviated expression of thoughts, feelings, and ideas.
ICYMI is a cousin of the more well-known BTW (by the way), but is often used more as a call to action, as in: ICYMI, you can still catch the show at the end of the week, rather than to draw attention to an interesting factoid.
In recent weeks, ICYMI has also been used in a more expansive way, as in ICYMI, I just got the highest grade in my class. Here, the person is using ICYMI to mean something like, I know you might have missed this because you weren't paying attention, but in fact, I did get the highest grade in my class and it is now public knowledge, and you need to be aware.
I should note that ICYMI is not the only initialism that is currently in vogue. Some others that are used in similar ways to ICYMI include FWIW (for what it's worth) and FYI (for your information).
